title: Specified tensor, evaluation and transposition comparison data
statement: Let $\mathcal B,\mathcal A$ be categories with fixed closed symmetric monoidal structures whose internal Homs are specified bifunctors [def-coef-ringed-tensor-hom-model]. For a functor $F$ and tensor comparison $\mu$, define tensor coherence to consist of a unit comparison and the associativity, left-unit, right-unit and symmetry equations. Define $\delta_K^W$ to be the transpose of evaluation after symmetry. For a Hom comparison $\chi$, define transposition laws to be the normalized uncurry and evaluation equations, naturality of both double-dual arrows, and their equality under the iterated comparison with $\chi^{-1}$ in the contravariant variable. For small ringed sites with commutative ring sheaves, use [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category, def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product, def-pc-tensor-complex-sheaves] to define the actual sheafified pure tensor and total-tensor summand inclusion. Let $U$ between the module categories be additive and exact. For the derived Hom comparison assume also preservation of small products and K-injective complexes. Underived comparison data specify coherent tensor and sheaf-Hom isomorphisms preserving canonical evaluation on these generators. Using the fixed derived structures and models [lem-sf-ringed-derived-closed-symmetric-monoidal, lem-sf-ringed-forget-two-injective-hom], define a representative square for a derived tensor transformation. Full comparison data consist of the chain comparison with its specified summands, derived comparison, representative square, coherent normalized unit and transposition laws. Unique extension means that every natural transformation satisfying that representative square equals the specified derived comparison. These are the existing definitions with unchanged names, parameters, fields and bodies; they assert no existence theorem.

structure TensorCoherence (mB : MonoidalCategory B) (mA : MonoidalCategory A)
    (βB : @SymmetricCategory B _ mB) (βA : @SymmetricCategory A _ mA)
    (F : B ⥤ A)
    (μ : @MonoidalCategory.tensor B _ mB ⋙ F ≅
      (F.prod F) ⋙ @MonoidalCategory.tensor A _ mA)
